overall_assessment:
For ordinary emneplaner (all 6 random controls and the Norsk/Spesialpedagogikk suspects) the h2-based split works: learning outcomes stay whole across Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse, arbeidskrav and assessment are cleanly separated, and the pre-pass flags (boilerplate on reused Norsk emne 4 plans, leak-> on topic bullets and a mid-sentence line break) are false alarms. The real defects come from content the emneplan hands off to the embedded 'Fagplan' block, which is never parsed: Praksis courses lose every section and about a third of courses lose teaching_methods. On top of that, oslomet's

sub-heading config never fires, so resit boilerplate stays in assessment. No reading_list exists in the harvested oslomet text, so its absence is not an extractor fault. Outside the packet, prerequisites rows also hold pointer and admission text ('Se programplanen for informasjon om eventuelle forkunnskapskrav…', 'Eksterne søkere må ha bestått lærerutdanning…').

findings.evidence: Grunnlaget for vurdering er læringsutbyttebeskrivelser for det enkelte studieår som er konkretisert i en vurderingsrapport.
findings.description: Praksis courses (M1GP*/M5GP*) get no sections at all, although the plan has substantive teaching_methods ('Organisering og arbeidsmåter': Observasjon, Undervisning, Veiledning), assessment ('Vurdering … Det er praksislærer som setter karakteren bestått/ikke bestått') and introductory content text. Every emneplan h2 (Forkunnskapskrav … Sensorordning) contains only 'Se fagplanen.', and the real text sits in the 'Fagplan' block on the same page. Rubric: sections clearly present in the plan were not extracted. In the full data, 135 of 148 Praksis offerings with no sections have a Fagplan block over 2,000 characters long. M1GP1000 2018 (packet course 2), whose Fagplan is only a URL, is correctly empty.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis:
R/extract_sections.R extract_sections_html(): the h2 'Fagplan' maps to NA in match_heading_to_section(), so its text is discarded. The emneplan h2s produce 7 rows (6 placeholder rows plus .drop), so the text_split fallback (nrow(out) < 3) in extract_sections() is checked BEFORE .clean_sections() and never fires. .clean_sections() then removes every 'Se fagplanen.' row, leaving 0 rows. The

sub-headings inside the Fagplan are also invisible (see the assessment finding: the li guard in .subheading_sections()).
findings.suggested_fix:
(1) In extract_sections(), decide on the fallback after .clean_sections(): if the cleaned output has fewer than 3 rows, try the alternative. (2) Add an oslomet Fagplan fallback, e.g. config section_fagplan_fallback = TRUE in R/institution_config.R. When an emneplan section is a 'Se fagplanen' placeholder, walk the li containing h2 'Fagplan', bucket its

sub-headings with match_heading_to_section() ('Organisering og arbeidsmåter'/'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' -> teaching_methods, 'Vurdering' -> assessment, 'Innledning' -> course_content), and fill only the sections whose emneplan text was a placeholder.

findings.evidence: Naturfaget i skolen er både et teoretisk og et praktisk fag, der det oppfordres til bruk av ulike arbeidsmåter og læringsarenaer.
findings.description: In many subject courses the emneplan's 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' says only 'Se fagplanen.'. The real teaching-methods text is in the same page's Fagplan block under 'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' (forelesninger, seminar, feltarbeid, ekskursjoner …), so no teaching_methods row is emitted. Two of six random controls (M1GNA2100, M1GEN2200) and suspect MGPE3300 show this. Oslomet's teaching_methods coverage is only 34% (499/1472). Of the 973 courses without a row, 870 have the 'Se fagplan' placeholder and 452 have a 'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' block on the page. The recovered text is subject-level, not course-level, which is why severity is medium.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Same mechanism as the Praksis finding. The 'Fagplan' h2 maps to NA, so its sub-sections are dropped, and .clean_sections() correctly removes the 'Se fagplanen.' placeholder, leaving nothing.
findings.suggested_fix:
Use the same Fagplan fallback as the Praksis finding, limited to teaching_methods. When the emneplan teaching_methods text is a placeholder, take the Fagplan sub-section whose

label matches 'fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' (add that pattern explicitly in R/section_heading_map.R; the substring 'arbeids- og undervisningsformer' already maps it). Mark the row so downstream users know it is subject-level text.

findings.evidence: Retten til å avlegge eksamen forutsetter godkjente arbeidskrav og deltakelse i bestemte faglige aktiviteter. Mer informasjon om arbeidskrav finnes i den innledende delen av fagplanen.
findings.description: In M5GRL2200 (KRLE 1, emne 2) the institution put the whole arbeidskrav block (80% attendance, mandatory workshop and excursions, 400-word reports) under the 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' h2, while 'Arbeidskrav og obligatoriske aktiviteter' says only 'Se fagplan.'. The heading-driven extractor files the coursework gates as teaching_methods, and no coursework_requirements row survives. The codebook assigns by meaning: these are pass/approve gates, so they belong in coursework_requirements. Found in 6 offerings, all M5GRL2200 from 2019 to 2021.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: html_headings trusts the source heading. .split_inline_coursework() only moves gate lines out of assessment, not out of teaching_methods, and it is not enabled for oslomet.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R, if a teaching_methods row starts with '^Retten til å avlegge eksamen (forutsetter|har som vilkår) godkjente arbeidskrav' and there is no coursework_requirements row (or only a placeholder one), relabel the row as coursework_requirements. Alternatively, extend .split_inline_coursework() to scan teaching_methods too.

findings.evidence: Ny/utsatt eksamen arrangeres som ved ordinær eksamen.
findings.description: Almost every oslomet assessment row keeps the resit block ('Ny/utsatt eksamen' or Nynorsk 'Ny/utsett eksamen' with its label and rules). The pipeline's own heading map classes this as exam logistics to drop (#215), and the rubric wants assessment to be the assessment design only. 1343 of 1472 oslomet assessment rows contain it. Leftover sub-heading labels such as 'Eksamensform' also stay as body lines.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis:
R/extract_sections.R .subheading_sections() discards every

with an ancestor::li. Oslomet wraps each h2 section in an accordion

  • , so config section_subheading_selector = 'p' never detects a sub-heading (0 found on the MGPE3300 page, even for

    Ny/utsatt eksamen

    ). The exact .drop row 'ny/utsatt eksamen' in R/section_heading_map.R therefore never fires, and the Nynorsk 'ny/utsett eksamen' is not in the map at all.
findings.suggested_fix: Safest fix: add an oslomet entry to .section_noise that removes the label lines '(?m)^Ny/uts[ae]tt eksamen\s*$' and the stock sentence '(?m)^(?:Deleksamen \d: )?Ny/uts[ae]tt eksamen (?:arrangeres|vert arrangert|gjennomføres) som ved ordinær eksamen\.?$'. Do not simply relax the li guard. A .drop sub-heading would swallow the text that follows it, such as 'Vurdering for studentar som tar faget 3. studieår', and sub-headings inside the NA 'Fagplan' parent would start pulling subject-level 'Vurdering'/'Arbeidskrav' text into sections. If the guard is relaxed, exempt only the accordion li and ignore sub-headings while parent_section is NA.

findings.evidence: Fagplanen tilhørende dette emnet er lagt på emne M5GKP2100 Kroppsøving 1, emne 1.
findings.description: The emneplan 'Innledning' h2 maps to course_content, so its navigation pointer ('Fagplanen som høyrer til / tilhørende dette emnet er lagt på emne …') is prepended to the real content. In M5GNO2100/3100 2023 it is the only Innledning text. 599 of 1472 oslomet course_content rows start with this pointer. The rest of the Innledning text is genuine course description, so the mapping itself is fine.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'innledning' maps to course_content in R/section_heading_map.R, and course_content gets no noise stripping: .strip_section_noise() runs only on assessment and coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), strip course_content lines matching '(?m)^Fagplanen (?:som (?:høyrer|hører|tilhører) til|tilhørende) dette emnet er lagt på emne [^\n]*$' (oslomet), then re-run the placeholder check.
